notes:
Account background: Support Sentinel AI (fka 'Sentinel Contact') — SaaS contact center provider serving retail and healthcare verticals. Evaluate Redwood for post-call summary automation + QA scoring to reduce QA FTE and speed coach feedback. Key wants: clean, labeled transcripts, short coaching bullets (3 per call), redaction of PHI, and an audit trail for supervisor reviews. POC scope: 2-week run focused on 5000 calls (sampled), deliver automated summary + highlight timestamps + QA metrics + agent score suggestions. Quote from CPO: "We need high precision on coaching highlights — false positives create extra work for coaches."

Technical / performance asks: target p95 inference latency for assistant suggestions <250ms (interactive UI), batch post-call summarization throughput 5k calls/day with bursts to 20k/day during promotions. Peak concurrency target: support 800 live agent sessions with spikes up to 2400 (require burst policy). Require deterministic fallback: if private infra overloaded, failover to a smaller hosted model variant for summary-only flows.

Model preferences and quality: prefer open/instruction-tuned models (cost sensitivity) with quantized profiles for GPU efficiency; want model quality baseline against internal human summaries (F1/ROUGE targets provided in Drive doc). Also interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization profiles to hit cost targets.

Integration notes: primary telephony stack: Genesys Cloud; need CTI events + recorded audio ingestion (we will upload S3 URIs to POC endpoint). Authentication: SSO (SAML) + API keys for service accounts; KMS for envelope encryption of transcripts. Retention: default 90d for transcripts, options for extended archival in on-prem if required.

Security interactions: SecOps requested SOC2 + penetration test pdfs; legal needs MDR clause about third-party model vendors; privacy asked for data residency controls (EU customers).

Procurement comments: procurement interested but wants burst SLA and itemized cost model for peak days. CSM engagement planned post-contract for rollout plan and coaching templates.

Next immediate tasks: provide SOC2 artifact, share POC infra checklist, supply SSO test account, confirm Genesys webhook schema. Owner action: Maya to push SOC2 to drive by 2026-03-03 and coordinate POC dates.
